create_lora_config: create a LoRAConfig instance with max_lora_rank, max_loras, and lora_dtype settings
validate_lora_config: validate LoRAConfig fields ensuring max_cpu_loras is >= max_loras and platform compatibility
verify_lora_with_model_config: verify LoRAConfig against a ModelConfig to resolve lora_dtype from the base model dtype
compute_lora_config_hash: compute a hash of LoRAConfig fields that affect the computation graph structure
configure_target_modules: configure LoRAConfig to restrict LoRA application to specific module suffixes for performance tuning
